name: Pill in the Pudding
source:
You're in some kind of polycule house sex dungeon. Your system is in shambles. Everyone here is god-awful at kidnapping.

So before you get rescued, why not make these freaks a half-decent dinner?

[From [url=https://sleepyjump.itch.io/pill-in-the-pudding]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正处于某种多孔性地牢中。你的系统一团糟。这里的每个人都擅长绑架。

所以在你获救之前，为什么不给这些怪物做一顿像样的晚餐呢？

[来自[url=https://sleepyjump.itch.io/pill-in-the-pudding]itch.io[/url]]
